encoding/quoted_printable#

Strict RFC 2045 quoted-printable over bytes.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

QuotedPrintableEncoded(
    origin: [byte(0), byte(61), byte(255)],
).bytes();
// ASCII bytes for "=00=3D=FF"

Description#

Strict RFC 2045 quoted-printable over bytes.

Encoding uses uppercase =HH, preserves CRLF hard line breaks, and inserts =\r\n soft breaks so every physical line is at most 76 bytes. Bare CR and LF are encoded rather than normalized. A space remains literal inside a line but is encoded at end of input or immediately before CRLF; a tab is always encoded, as =09.

Decoding accepts uppercase or lowercase ASCII hex. It rejects malformed escapes, bare CR/LF, non-ASCII literals, trailing literal whitespace and physical lines longer than 76 bytes. No replacement, newline conversion or charset conversion occurs. InvalidQuotedPrintable.offset() is the byte offset of the first violation.
